stem: Measles virus transmission includes which airspace property after an infectious person leaves a room?

options.label: A
options.text: Only fecal-oral spread in swimming pools
options.misconception: Enteric distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong route; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Only fomite spread on stainless steel for weeks
options.explanation: CDC emphasizes droplets and airborne nuclei.

options.label: C
options.text: Airborne persistence for up to 2 hours indoors
options.explanation: CDC: airborne in closed areas up to 2 hours.

options.label: D
options.text: Only vector bite from Anopheles mosquitoes
options.misconception: Malaria distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong route; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Only iatrogenic spread via blood transfusion
options.explanation: Wrong route; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: measles airborne persistence in closed spaces.
